proposedContributions.change: Define versioned typed request/result/error schemas. BaseDefinition stores canonical page ref/contentKind=base, source binding, stable field definitions, schemaVersion/schemaRevision and config revision plus scoped ViewDefinitions, never authoritative row arrays. Shared/private views have explicit scope/ownership and own configRevision. ViewPreference is separate actor-local viewport/search/selection/active-view state indexed by workspace/page/view/schemaVersion within actor scope. proposedContributions.change: Implement a Page-authority-backed facade, not a second JSON/SQLite Base store. Resolve the authenticated principal and source policy before read/create/write; CAS shared config as authorized editor, create private views only if permitted, and keep personal preferences isolated. Config failure does not roll back native Task changes. Preserve future/corrupt payloads untouched and reject writes to them.

risks: Published RS-BASE-01 has broader typed-record/Board/CRM/search/export acceptance than this LSX bounded definition slice. Preserve it as outstanding integrated feature acceptance rather than treating LSX-WP-007 as all of RS-BASE-01.

Only two renderer shared patch paths are normative; actual end-to-end runtime registration/callers and locale writes may require additional reviewed scope. Exact undiscovered symbols are deliberately not fabricated.
PageConfig.share is HTML publication bookkeeping, not authorization for Base shared config; PageKind runtime enum must not be replaced by contentKind.
Workspace-only localStorage keys and initialization-only React state can mix actors/pages or persist old context after a switch. Personal views/preferences must never publish automatically.
Legacy restoreSavedViews silently drops invalid/future entries and substitutes a default; routing new Base bytes through it risks loss and false saved-state UI.
New SourceSelector/FieldDefinitions must reuse accepted foundation contracts; a standalone selector/row store/query engine would duplicate authority and violate scope.
A Page-backed facade with unconnected registration/transport is not an implementation. Authenticated policy and durable command/outbox receipts are required at every real boundary.
Schema/config CAS is separate from source row CAS; a config conflict must not undo a successful native Task commit. Duplicate view is not duplicate dataset.
